data.one_liner: Expandable text widget with trim, linkify, annotations, fade, and programmatic control
data.what_it_does: It displays a block of text that can be collapsed or expanded with smooth animations. It supports character, line, or word trimming, rich text, auto‑linkify, hashtags/mentions, fade effects, and a controller for programmatic state changes.
use_when: You need a read‑more widget that trims text by characters, lines, or words
You want to preserve rich text formatting and tappable spans when truncating
You need auto‑linkify URLs or custom annotations like hashtags and mentions
You want a selectable text area or custom expand/collapse buttons
avoid_when: You require a highly custom animation that cannot be achieved with the built‑in curve and duration
You are building a very large text block that might need more efficient rendering than a single widget
strengths: Rich text support with recognizers and WidgetSpan preservation
weaknesses: No documented support for extremely large text blocks
Limited to Flutter; no native platform integration beyond Flutter
data.minimal_example:
SeeMoreWidget(
  "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit...",
  maxCharacters: 100,
  linkify: true,
  annotations: [
    SeeMoreAnnotation.hashtag(onTap: (tag) => print(tag)),
    SeeMoreAnnotation.mention(onTap: (user) => print(user)),
  ],
  controller: _ctrl,
)
